items.reason: The single relative modifier “who spoke to the king” is clear. The woman’s complaint directly supports the expected answer.
The question has one ordinary temporal clause, “when the man of God prays.” The restoration of the king’s hand is directly stated.
The supplied passage identifies the person only as “神人”; it does not support the keyed option’s identifying detail “从犹大来的.”
“是为了什么结果” is unnatural question phrasing that conflates purpose and result. The intended target is recoverable from “愿神也听你们的话.”
The direct actor question is clearly worded, and the passage explicitly identifies “那五个窥探地的人” as taking the listed objects.
“由谁统领” clearly asks who commanded the specified force. “他们统领的军队” refers directly to the preceding “二千六百” family leaders.
“After the man of God leaves” is an overly broad sequence anchor: the passage includes his departure from Bethel and his later departure from the prophet’s house.
Within the supplied short sequence, “最先” clearly distinguishes the five men’s initial removal of the objects from the priest’s later taking of them. Only C matches the first event.
The question directly asks who handed over the weapons. The passage identifies the priest as “祭司耶何耶大.”
This is a straightforward why question. “由于保罗第二天准备离开” explicitly supports A.
